Daily father & son walk. ☀️

Video

My dad proposed to my mom the second time they met.

They married less than a year later, had 5 kids, 11 grandchildren (with more to come), and will celebrate 50 years of marriage this year.

Simpler times. 😃
Heading to Miami later this month. 🔥
Run your life in such a way that you always have something to look forward to, even if it's small.

Reminding myself. 💜


ZUBY: (@ZubyMusic)

This a reminder that you are not obligated to argue with every random idiot on the internet.



— https://nitter.net/ZubyMusic/status/1809231038482117099#m

I've called out anti-white racism many times over the years. Don't be retarded.

Not all black people are the same or have the same opinions. I know some people struggle with the seeing people as individuals thing. But it's not that hard in practice.


Goban (@GreatGoban)

Yes, but all Whites must be punished as a group because one group of them did something a long time ago. This is what YOUR people IN POWER are saying so please stop posting your holier than thou bullshit takes when Whites are

A few years ago, I recorded an interview with an American guy who has 16 children with his wife.

They're not rich. He is the sole income earner and they homeschooled all their kids. They eschewed luxuries that many people wouldn't even consider luxuries anymore. 

I often think back to that conversation when people talk about being unable to afford children and how 'the economy' is the main reason birth rates have collapsed.

It's more a matter of lifestyle expectations, priorities, and unwilli

Yes, all we 'blacks' behave exactly the same way. All billion or so of us. Exactly the same. 🙄


Samantha Thompson 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 (@SamLovesEngland)

Well that's funny considering blacks behave in the exact same way whatever culture or environment they are in on Earth. 

Almost like the behaviour is in their genes or something.



— https://nitter.net/SamLovesEngland/status/2044048000046047256#m

Most human behaviour is memetic.

Most people will do what most people do. That's why culture and environment are so important.

Its a very basic point with very complex effects.

When someone's preferred candidate wins, elections are free and fair and democracy is good. 

When someone's preferred candidate loses, elections are rigged and democracy is a scam.

Happens every time.

Creating a life that you enjoy and are proud of is 100% up to you. I know that upsets some people because we live in an anti-accountability culture and it's easy to blame eveybody except yourself.
But it's up to you. Nobody else can do it for you.

I've been on social media for over 20 years...

I've seen a lot. 😂

My last public conversation with @ScottAdamsSays 

Uploading it here for posterity. Rest in peace. 💜
